text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there, Trainer-san.
This is a bit sudden, but... do you have some free time tomorrow?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, as part of my volunteer activities,
I'm going to visit a hospital.
If you'd like, would you care to join me, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There are a lot of long-term hospitalized patients, you see. I thought having your gentle smile by my side might bring them even more comfort, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!
Well then, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Child Patient
text_block_list.text:
It's an Umamusume!
Whoa, what a pretty tail!
Hey, hey, are you really fast at running too, big sis?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll show you next time.
Big sis won't even lose to a car.

text_block_list.name: Child Patient
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! No way... heheh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Isn't the sunlight too bright?
Let me draw the curtains—

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't mind me.
Keeping me company will only drag your spirits down.
Go spend time with the other girls."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While some return a smile,
others keep their heads down, refusing to look up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout it all, Fuji Kiseki maintained a gentle smile, never letting her expression slip.
And so, the charity visit came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell you the truth,
I had planned a surprise that would make everyone smile and catch them off guard."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, I couldn't do it. The people gathered there are carrying so many different feelings.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even a smile
can bring pain to someone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To cheer someone up... I've come to realize the weight of that action.
I still have a long way to go myself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Even so...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm still right here.
After all, you agreed to see me,
even though you could have just turned me down."

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text:
............
Even though you can't even hold a fun conversation?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just the fact that you're trying to talk to me...
Do you have any idea how much
happiness that brings me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I came here and met you.

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text:
Not to please me, but simply because
it makes you happy?
...Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text: Even someone like me can still make someone happy, can't she...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...That person told me
that they would watch my race."

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text:
""To have the person I brought happiness to win...
It's truly like a 'miracle.'""

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to make people smile.
That hasn't changed, even now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yet out there, far more than I ever imagined,
it exists in so many different forms.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's why I...
choice_data_list: I've gotta show them the greatest "miracle" ever!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Smiles and happiness...
I wasn't the one giving them; they were given to me.
And beyond that, they sought victory from me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I will give this race my all!
To fulfill their expectations, and show them
the "miracle" they've been wishing for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki spoke her resolution toward the dazzling sky. Her profile shone brightly enough to rival the sun itself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...No, I feel like I've just been given a push forward!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely win, no matter what kind of race it is!
After all, my name means 'Miracle'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I playfully tell her that it wouldn't really be much of a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Ah, indeed.
In that case—a simple victory won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We've got to captivate everyone with our running
and give them the greatest surprise of all!
